title: Previewing a file from Recent throws an error if the file isn’t there anymore.
author: lei9444
summary: Selecting a stale file entry from File Explorer Home causes the Monaco preview handler to expose a raw FileNotFoundException instead of a friendly unavailable-file state.
next_action: Approve a focused missing-file guard and friendly preview error design.

confidence.rationale: The exception site and required guard are directly evidenced.

judgment.rationale: The screenshot contains the exact exception and current Monaco preview code dereferences FileInfo.Length without first checking that the path still exists.
evidence: The screenshot shows FileInfo.get_Length throwing for a missing deps.json file selected from File Explorer Home.
Current DoPreview constructs FileInfo(filePath) and immediately reads Length inside its preview path.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a focused missing-file guard and friendly preview error design.

fix_assessment.rationale: No linked fix is present, and the public stack plus current source identify a small repository-side error-handling gap.

issue_context.summary: Selecting a stale file entry from File Explorer Home causes the Monaco preview handler to expose a raw FileNotFoundException instead of a friendly unavailable-file state.
known_information: The selected path no longer exists.
The screenshot exposes the missing path and Monaco preview stack.
inferences: A pre-read existence guard should prevent this specific raw exception without changing normal preview rendering.
issue_context.analysis: This is a narrow error-handling defect with direct stack-to-source evidence, so a queued design is more useful than asking the reporter for information already shown.
initial_investigation: Downloaded and inspected the public screenshot.

actions.label: Approve stale-preview missing-file guard
actions.design_summary: Check File.Exists before FileInfo.Length and show the preview handler's friendly unavailable-file state.
actions.note: Approval would start a separate fork-side design workflow; this lightweight pass writes no code or upstream content.

proposed_fixes.title: Handle stale File Explorer Home entries before reading preview metadata
proposed_fixes.root_cause: MonacoPreviewHandlerControl.DoPreview reads FileInfo.Length for the shell-supplied path before validating that the file still exists, so a stale Recent/Home entry surfaces FileNotFoundException text.
plan: In MonacoPreviewHandlerControl.DoPreview, validate the string path and File.Exists before reading FileInfo.Length.
Route a missing path to the preview handler's existing user-facing error surface and stop initialization for that item.
Add a focused unit test that passes a deleted temporary path and asserts a friendly error rather than an exception.
verification: Delete a file that remains listed in File Explorer Home, select it with Preview enabled, and confirm a friendly unavailable-file message.
Confirm existing files still render and oversized-file handling remains unchanged.

confidence.rationale: The screenshot's stack and current source meet at the unguarded FileInfo.Length access.
